text: ok its not breaking the texture anymore. but lets talk about this LoD and view distance because its a real problem st ill. i can tell because at certain areas where i look my fps goes to shit. and i suspect that all the grass and tree animations are in full effect at full distance, also, this change seem to break the skybox physics ? idk. they worked last load.
resolution: Diagnosed the fps/LOD problem in the compiled world. Three compounding causes confirmed in code: (1) ~2.6M grass/tree rows overflow the 1.05M static instance buffer so visible foliage is re-staged into the per-frame buffer EVERY frame; (2) streaming used ONE 240m residency radius for all families so short grass drew to full distance; (3) the grass/frond wind shader animated every drawn blade with no distance gate. All three scale with visible foliage count, hence the directional fps drop. Also flagged: the empty far-field (lod shell 0 rows) is the same root number (3.5M rows > MAX_STATIC_INSTANCES). Implemented the fix under req_1665 (per-family foliage view distance + animation cut). Skybox/physics shift the user noticed is a DIFFERENT lane (2117) mid-work on SKYBOX_PLAYBOOK void-shell in world_loader.zig+camera.zig, not my change.
